title: Direct graphical manipulation
summary: Implement pointer manipulation for semantic containers without replacing the model with absolute coordinates.
criteria: Implement selection, drag/reorder/reparent and resize with an immutable gesture preview, one validated transaction on commit, cancellation and stale-revision/session checks.
Implement applicable snapping, alignment and pan behavior; retain semantic constraints and test unsupported operations explicitly.
blockers: Independent final-head review and exact-head hosted CI pending.
Native desktop interaction and prototype comparison deferred to RUST-04 acceptance; non-flow layouts and runtime parity remain explicitly unsupported in this slice.

history.summary: Reserved RUST-04C from verified main bfd81fc; reconciled PR #25 engineering integration and carried native validation to RUST-04.

Implemented selection, flow reorder/reparent, resize with snap, pan and semantic cross-axis alignment through existing typed transactions; local 17 frontend tests, TypeScript/Vite and isolated browser gesture fixture passed. No native acceptance claimed.
